title: Arkansas trooper threw teen down and punched her in the face during traffic stop, lawsuit says
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. Reports are focusing on this development: Arkansas trooper threw teen down and punched her in the face during traffic stop, lawsuit says.
